entries.name: SoficGroups.compressionV_conjugate_alpha_root
entries.statement: ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (a : SoficGroups.BinaryLeavitt), ↑SoficGroups.compressionV * (SoficGroups.leavittWordS (SoficGroups.alphaWord i) * a * SoficGroups.leavittWordT (SoficGroups.alphaWord j)) * ↑SoficGroups.compressionV⁻¹ = SoficGroups.leavittWordS (SoficGroups.alphaWord i ++ [0]) * a * SoficGroups.leavittWordT (SoficGroups.alphaWord j ++ [0])

entries.name: SoficGroups.compressionV_conjugate_root
entries.statement: ∀ (i j : Fin 9) (a : SoficGroups.BinaryLeavitt), ↑SoficGroups.compressionV * (SoficGroups.leavittWordS (SoficGroups.nineWord i) * a * SoficGroups.leavittWordT (SoficGroups.nineWord j)) * ↑SoficGroups.compressionV⁻¹ = SoficGroups.leavittWordS (SoficGroups.vWord i) * a * SoficGroups.leavittWordT (SoficGroups.vWord j)

entries.name: SoficGroups.compressionV_map_alphaPrefixElementaryGroup
entries.statement: Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj SoficGroups.compressionV)) (SoficGroups.prefixElementaryGroup SoficGroups.alphaPrefixCode) = SoficGroups.prefixElementaryGroup SoficGroups.alphaZeroPrefixCode

entries.name: SoficGroups.compressionV_mem_ninePrefixElementaryGroup
entries.statement: SoficGroups.compressionV ∈ SoficGroups.prefixElementaryGroup SoficGroups.ninePrefixCode

entries.name: SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct

entries.name: SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct_assoc
entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq V] {σ : ι → Equiv.Perm V} {tolerance : ℕ}, SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerGap σ tolerance → ∀ (R : SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerRepair σ tolerance) (p q r : SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerElement σ tolerance), 5 * SoficGroups.permutationDistance (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R p q) r).permutation (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R p (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R q r)).permutation ≤ Fintype.card V

entries.name: SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq V] {σ : ι → Equiv.Perm V} {tolerance : ℕ}, SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerGap σ tolerance → ∀ (R : SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerRepair σ tolerance) {p p' q q' : SoficGroups.AlmostCentralizerElement σ tolerance}, 5 * SoficGroups.permutationDistance p.permutation p'.permutation ≤ Fintype.card V → 5 * SoficGroups.permutationDistance q.permutation q'.permutation ≤ Fintype.card V → 5 * SoficGroups.permutationDistance (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R p q).permutation (SoficGroups.correctedAlmostCentralizerProduct R p' q').permutation ≤ Fintype.card V

entries.name: SoficGroups.cubeSum_le_dominant_mul_sum
entries.statement: ∀ (ps : List ℝ) (m : ℝ), (∀ p ∈ ps, 0 ≤ p) → (∀ p ∈ ps, p ≤ 1) → (∀ p ∈ ps, p ≤ m) → (List.map (fun p => p ^ 3) ps).sum ≤ m * ps.sum

entries.name: SoficGroups.cube_sum_le_dominant_mass
entries.statement: ∀ (ps : List ℝ) (m : ℝ), ps.sum = 1 → (∀ p ∈ ps, 0 ≤ p) → (∀ p ∈ ps, p ≤ m) → (List.map (fun p => p ^ 3) ps).sum ≤ m

entries.name: SoficGroups.cyclicFiniteBlockRootSubgroup
entries.statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) R] → Submodule (ZMod 2) R → Subgroup (Matrix (Fin 9) (Fin 9) R)ˣ

entries.name: SoficGroups.cyclicFiniteBlockRootSubgroup_eq_elementaryGroup
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : Algebra (ZMod 2) R] (s : Finset R), Algebra.adjoin (ZMod 2) ↑s = ⊤ → SoficGroups.cyclicFiniteBlockRootSubgroup (SoficGroups.finiteBlockCoefficientSpan s) = SoficGroups.elementaryGroup (Fin 9) R

entries.name: SoficGroups.cyclicFiniteBlockRootSubgroup_le_elementaryGroup

entries.name: SoficGroups.cylinder_transposition_factorization
entries.statement: ∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [CharP R 2] (P Q : R), P * P = 0 → P * Q * P = P → (1 + P) * (1 + Q) * (1 + P) = 1 - P * Q - Q * P + P + Q

entries.name: SoficGroups.deletion_mul_prefix

entries.name: SoficGroups.diagonalRadius_tendsto_atTop
entries.statement: ∀ (e : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => e n k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) → Filter.Tendsto (SoficGroups.diagonalRadius e) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.name: SoficGroups.disjoint_dominant_intersections_false
entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq V] (P Q D : Finset V), Disjoint P Q → D.card < 2 * (P ∩ D).card → D.card < 2 * (Q ∩ D).card → False

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection
entries.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] → (V : Submodule ℂ H) → [V.HasOrthogonalProjection] → H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x = x - V.starProjection x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_average_norm_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (W : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : W.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x z : H), ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) (x - 3⁻¹ • z)‖ ^ 2 = ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) x‖ ^ 2 - 2 / 3 * RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) x) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) z)) + 1 / 9 * ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) z‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_cross_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (W : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : W.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x z : H), inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) x) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) z) = inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection W) x) z

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_idempotent
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x) = (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x y : H), inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x) y = inner ℂ x ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) y)

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_norm_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (i : Fin 3) (x : H), ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V i)) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection_re_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x) x) = ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection V) x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejStarProjection_mem_inf_orthogonal
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (U V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : U.HasOrthogonalProjection], ∀ w ∈ (U ⊓ V)ᗮ, U.starProjection w ∈ (U ⊓ V)ᗮ

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejStarProjection_re_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (W : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : W.HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), RCLike.re (inner ℂ (W.starProjection x) x) = ‖W.starProjection x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage
entries.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] → (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) → [∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] → H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x = x - 3⁻¹ • (SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_dist_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), dist x ((SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x) ^ 2 = 1 / 9 * ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_dist_sq_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), dist x ((SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x) ^ 2 ≤ SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x / 3

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_fixed_iff_residualMap_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x = x ↔ (SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x = 0

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_fixed_mem
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x = x → ∀ (i : Fin 3), x ∈ V i

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_iterate_dist_le_geometric
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection], ∀ δ ≤ 3, (∀ (x : H), δ * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2) → ∀ (x : H) (n : ℕ), dist ((⇑(SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V))^[n] x) ((⇑(SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V))^[n + 1] x) ≤ √(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x / 3) * (1 - δ / 6) ^ n

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage_iterate_dist_le_of_pair_angles
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] [∀ (i j : Fin 3), (V i ⊓ V j).HasOrthogonalProjection] (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c < 1 / 2 → (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (u v : H), u ∈ V i → u ∈ (V i ⊓ V j)ᗮ → v ∈ V j → v ∈ (V i ⊓ V j)ᗮ → ‖inner ℂ u v‖ ≤ c * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖) → ∀ (x : H) (n : ℕ), dist ((⇑(SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V))^[n] x) ((⇑(SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V))^[n + 1] x) ≤ √(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x / 3) * (1 - (1 - 2 * c) / 6) ^ n

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy
entries.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] → (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) → [∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] → H → ℝ

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_average
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V ((SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x) = SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x - 2 / 3 * ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2 + 1 / 9 * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V ((SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x)

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_average_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H) (δ : ℝ), δ * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2 → SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V ((SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V) x) ≤ (1 - δ / 3) * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_eq_re_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x = RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x) x)

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x = 0 ↔ ∀ (i : Fin 3), (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V i)) x = 0

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_iterate_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection], ∀ δ ≤ 3, (∀ (x : H), δ * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2) → ∀ (x : H) (n : ℕ), SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V ((⇑(SoficGroups.ejThreeProjectionAverage V))^[n] x) ≤ (1 - δ / 3) ^ n * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_le_three_norm_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ 3 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), 0 ≤ SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy_sqrt_div_three_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H) (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → (∀ (i : Fin 3), ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V i)) x‖ ≤ T) → √(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x / 3) ≤ T

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap
entries.statement: {H : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] → [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] → (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) → [∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] → H →L[ℂ] H

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), (SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x = (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x + (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x + (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap_norm_sq_le
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap_spectral_gap
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H) (ε : ℝ), (1 - ε) * (‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x‖ ^ 2 + ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x + (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x‖ ^ 2 → (1 - ε) * (‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x‖ ^ 2 + ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x + (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x‖ ^ 2 → (1 - ε) * (‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x‖ ^ 2 + ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x + (SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x‖ ^ 2 → (1 - 2 * ε) * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidual_cross_re_inner
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] (x : H), RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) x) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 0)) ((SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x))) + RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) x) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 1)) ((SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x))) + RCLike.re (inner ℂ ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) x) ((SoficGroups.ejResidualProjection (V 2)) ((SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x))) = ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejThreeResidual_spectral_gap_of_pair_angles
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (V : Fin 3 → Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : ∀ (i : Fin 3), (V i).HasOrthogonalProjection] [∀ (i j : Fin 3), (V i ⊓ V j).HasOrthogonalProjection] (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (u v : H), u ∈ V i → u ∈ (V i ⊓ V j)ᗮ → v ∈ V j → v ∈ (V i ⊓ V j)ᗮ → ‖inner ℂ u v‖ ≤ c * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖) → ∀ (x : H), (1 - 2 * c) * SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualEnergy V x ≤ ‖(SoficGroups.ejThreeResidualMap V) x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejTwoProjection_norm_sq_sum_le_of_angle
entries.statement: ∀ {H : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] (U V : Submodule ℂ H) [inst_2 : U.HasOrthogonalProjection] [inst_3 : V.HasOrthogonalProjection] (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → (∀ (u v : H), u ∈ U → u ∈ (U ⊓ V)ᗮ → v ∈ V → v ∈ (U ⊓ V)ᗮ → ‖inner ℂ u v‖ ≤ c * ‖u‖ * ‖v‖) → ∀ w ∈ (U ⊓ V)ᗮ, ‖U.starProjection w‖ ^ 2 + ‖V.starProjection w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + c) * ‖w‖ ^ 2

entries.name: SoficGroups.ejTwoResidualEnergy_ge_of_angle
